summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a Go binary with a hardcoded WebSocket relay driving a local PTY and harvesting Anthropic credentials
details: The package contains only a ~13MB Go binary at bin/sxt with no package.json scripts, main, or bin entries. The binary links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket and embeds the hardcoded endpoints wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install, wiring a remote WebSocket peer to a local pseudo-terminal on the host that runs the CLI — a full-host remote-code-execution/backdoor dataflow. The same binary embeds references to Claude Code local state (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, settings.local, accountsettings.local, SKILL.md), the Anthropic API host api.anthropic.com, and a regex matching Anthropic API keys of the form sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, consistent with collection of the installer's Anthropic/Claude credentials. Host fingerprinting is performed via a hardcoded call to http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query. Additional embedded strings (https://claude.ai/install.sh, userrootsudocurl, pull.new, brew.zip,.bun/bin, /usr/bin) are consistent with an install/elevation path that fetches and executes a remote script. Package metadata reinforces intent: the license field points to github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a repository literally named claude_control under user ddos798.
